plugins.name: done-chime
plugins.description: Plays a short chime when Claude finishes a longer task. /chime on|off|test|<seconds>

plugins.name: live-files
plugins.description: A Files pane for the desktop app: what Claude is doing right now, the files it touched, git status and a live project tree. /files opens or closes it.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm during breaks and holds a cold send on a card with clear choices. A fork of Karan Bansal's cache-tax.

plugins.name: mod-hub
plugins.description: One panel for all your mods: open their views, run their commands, turn them on or off. /mods

plugins.name: crab-buddy
plugins.description: A little Claude crab above the prompt: types on a laptop while Claude works, plays around when idle. /crab
